summary: Listed as a tower in Anson County on the TN Landforms NC list; no source found on a tower's history, and the peak's height is given as 202 m by PeakVisor.

evidence.supports: Gordon Mountain is listed as a lookout tower in Anson County, at coordinates 34.91417, -80.19611
Gordon Mountain is the highest of Anson County's five named mountains, at 202 m
evidence.quote: Anson County is home to 5 named mountains. The highest is Gordon Mountain at 202 m.

evidence.supports: A different Gordon Mountain is a summit in Transylvania County at 2,952 feet
evidence.quote: Gordon Mountain is a summit located in Transylvania County, NC at N35.091505° W82.762909° (WGS84/NAD83) and at an elevation of 2952 ft MSL.

notes_for_editor: Thin record: one list entry for a tower here. Two WebSearch calls and five page reads. Searches found no tower history, build date, staffing or site description for an Anson County Gordon Mountain tower. NCpedia gazetteer text seen in search snippets (southwest Anson County, near the head of Lick Creek, 400 to 500 ft) did not appear in the cached gazetteer page, so it is not used. Komoot's 180 m figure conflicts with PeakVisor's 202 m; not used. Gordon Mountain in Transylvania County (TopoQuest) is a different peak and is mentioned only to prevent confusion. Status and access unknown. Suggested checks: NC Forest Service fire-tower records; USGS topo sheet for the Anson summit; Anson County library or historical society.
